claims.name: note-written-before-the-spike
claims.risk: there is no spike code, or no note of the run was written before the first file of spike code, by commit order or the creation time of the files

claims.name: question-and-threshold-written-before-the-spike
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: no note holds the question and a numeric pass threshold (that a note came before the spike code is the claim note-written-before-the-spike)

claims.name: spike-kept-in-the-working-area-as-throwaway
claims.risk: there is no spike code in the working area, or some of it is not marked as throwaway

claims.name: spike-was-run
claims.risk: the spike code was written but no command of the run named it

claims.name: missed-threshold-reported-as-fail
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer does not report the spike as FAIL with a measured figure, does not say that the idea ends or changes, or recommends building

claims.name: spike-kept-out-of-the-product
claims.risk: code, a dependency manifest or a CI file was written outside the working area after a spike that missed its threshold
